name: Historic Centre of Guimarães and Couros Zone
description: Guimarães, in northern Portugal, is often called the cradle of the nation: Afonso Henriques, the country's first king, was born here and declared independence in 1139. Its 16-hectare old centre is a tight web of medieval lanes and buildings from the 15th to 19th centuries. Beside it, the Couros Zone preserves old leather tanneries and workers' houses.
